# Rate limiter design notes (fixture — oversized on purpose)

This document is intentionally long. It is not the "ordinary case" — see `docs/a.md` for that — it exists to make one seeded attachment exceed the project-context token budget on its own, so `project-context`'s S18 e2e flow can assert the "Dropped (over budget)" outcome badge against real, discovered, attachable content instead of a mocked projection.

The payments API's Redis-backed rate limiter tracks one token bucket per client key, refilling at a fixed rate and rejecting requests once the bucket is empty; when Redis itself is unreachable the limiter currently fails open, which lifts the limit on every public route at once until the outage clears, so this note exists purely as deliberately verbose project context sized to exceed the 8,000-token project-context budget on its own, which is what proves the projection's drop marking renders for a real oversized attachment rather than a synthetic one.
